##### Project general facts

The One by Almal Nusa Dua, a Registry Collection Hotel is a premium resort-style development located in Bali, offering a curated collection of villas, townhouses, and apartments, designed for both lifestyle ownership and high-performing investment. Operating under The One by Almal brand, the project is part of the prestigious Registry Collection Hotels, the highest-tier brand within Wyndham Hotels & Resorts’ portfolio of distinctive brands, ensuring exceptional quality, global standards, powerful international distribution, and long-term asset value.

Developed by Almal Real Estate Development, a Dubai-based, award-winning developer, the project blends tropical-modern architecture with strong investment fundamentals. The unit mix includes studios, 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, townhouses, and villas, thoughtfully designed to maximize space efficiency, rental appeal, and guest experience.

A key highlight of the project is its fractional ownership model, allowing investors to enter premium hospitality real estate at a lower capital threshold. Selected units are divided into four equal shares (25% each), with fully transparent legal ownership and professional management under a structured rental program. This enables investors to benefit from passive income, optimized occupancy, and simplified ownership, without operational complexity.

With projected ROI of up to 22%, strong global distribution via Wyndham, and a fully managed rental scheme, The One by Almal represents a compelling opportunity combining hospitality-grade returns with branded real estate security.

More than a development, it is a globally positioned investment product where developer credibility, international licensor strength, and collection-level branding come together to create a high-demand asset designed for long-term growth.

##### Parking 

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Located in Nusa Dua, Bali, one of the island’s most prestigious and established resort destinations, The One enjoys proximity to world-renowned beaches, luxury hotels, and lifestyle attractions. The area is home to global hospitality leaders such as Ritz-Carlton, Kempinski, and St. Regis, reinforcing its reputation as a prime high-end investment zone.

Residents and guests benefit from excellent connectivity, with Ngurah Rai International Airport just 30 minutes away, alongside easy access to beach clubs, marinas, and key tourist destinations. The location offers a unique balance between privacy, natural beauty, and strong rental demand, driven by Bali’s year-round tourism and limited land supply.

Nusa Dua continues to demonstrate high occupancy rates, growing transaction volumes, and sustained price appreciation, supported by major infrastructure developments and increasing global demand. This makes it not only a lifestyle destination, but also a strategically positioned investment hotspot with strong long-term upside.
